# Vendored packages

## agent-contracts-analyzer-0.1.1.tgz

Built npm pack output from `foo-log-inc/agent-contracts-analyzer` tag `v0.1.1`.
The git dependency omits `dist/` in the published file list, so CI and installs use this tarball instead of `github:foo-log-inc/agent-contracts-analyzer#v0.1.1`.
